plugins.name: lemlist
plugins.description: 38-skill GTM / outbound library from lemlist (l3mpire/claude-skills) — ICP, sourcing, cold email & LinkedIn copywriting, campaign design, benchmarking, CRM hygiene, n8n automation. Minus the Claap-specific skill.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: General-purpose technical skills. youtube-transcript: read any YouTube video's transcript as plain text (yt subtitles), no API key or cookie. scrapling: web scraping via the Scrapling lib (Fetcher decision tree, Cloudflare bypass, login sessions, HTML parsing); needs an open network (local/VPS).

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Productivity skills. grill-me (stress-test a plan via relentless interview), handoff (compact a conversation into a handoff doc), write-a-skill (author new skills properly), write-like-me (rewrite in the user's own voice, no AI tells), malt-response (winning Malt proposal playbook), malt-workflow (end-to-end Malt offer handling: pulls the offer from Gmail, judges fit, drafts the reply + a direct reinforcement email, or builds a profile-ranking dossier when off-target), brainstorm (structured brainstorm: grill-me interrogation + superpowers design flow, idea to validated design/action plan).
